verdict.rationale: Paxos is an API-first platform. It uses OAuth 2 client-credentials auth, a machine-to-machine flow suited to unattended automation, with scoped API credentials. A Developer Sandbox replicates v2 API functionality for end-to-end integration testing with test funds. Polling workflows and REST, FIX and WebSocket APIs let operations run headlessly without the dashboard. Missing for 10: no CLI or explicit CI/CD guidance, some setup still dashboard-driven (webhook configuration, sandbox Fund button), no published OpenAPI spec found by probe, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
